title: Caffeine
description: Turn Caffeine's keep-awake on or off through the activity it exports for that purpose. Caffeine reports no state back, so each action says the request was handed over, never what the screen timeout is now.
setup: Install Caffeine (moe.zhs.caffeine); these actions pin its toggle activity and fail if it is absent.

tool.name: enable
tool.title: Enable keep-awake
tool.description: Ask Caffeine to keep the screen awake. Uses the installed Caffeine app. State cannot be read back; a successful launch is handoff evidence only.

receipts.success: Enable keep-awake request handed to Caffeine. Its resulting state is not verified.

tool.name: disable
tool.title: Disable keep-awake
tool.description: Ask Caffeine to stop keeping the screen awake. Uses the installed Caffeine app. State cannot be read back; a successful launch is handoff evidence only.

receipts.success: Disable keep-awake request handed to Caffeine. Its resulting state is not verified.
